content.comment_body: Hello, I'm new to programming. I would like to know if it's possible to have more than one alarm message active and shown at the same time on the [product_name] operator device. Thanks.

All active message texts are displayed on the [product_name] operator device. However, it works like a stack, meaning the text with the highest priority is shown on top. You can view other messages by scrolling with the cursor keys.

There is plenty of space and available message texts in the [product_name], so you can combine alarms. For example, use text field 1 for Alarm 1, text field 2 for Alarm 2. If both alarms are active, use text field 3 to show both alarm messages together.
The simplest way I've found to handle multiple alarms is to use the On/Off function within a text message, as demonstrated in the attachment.

analysis.insight_summary: Users discussed how alarm messages are handled on the [product_name] operator device, explaining that while several alarms can be active at once, only the message with the highest priority is displayed initially. Other active messages can be viewed by scrolling, and suggestions were made for combining multiple alarms in a single message using device functions. The conversation reveals an intuitive alarm handling system, but also points out that simultaneous multi-alarm display isn't supported natively, which could impact usability in some situations.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants to have multiple alarm messages displayed at the same time on the [product_name] operator device and to be able to easily view all active alarms.
